content.myth: We'll find a house after we land
content.fact: Sort your stay before you fly
content.detail: Arrange at least your first few weeks before you leave. Start with seniors and the university housing page.

caption:
Myth: we'll find a house after we land ❌

Fact: sort your stay before you fly. Hunting for a house after landing is one of the most stressful things you can do.
